hotkeys.title: Presenter mode
hotkeys.subtitle: Forces presenter blur on or off

guide.tagline: Blur private details in Edith while you share your screen.
guide.summary: Presenter hides things like music, cost figures, calendar events and agents inside Edith while you present or record. It can turn on by itself when it sees screen sharing, or you switch it by hand with a shortcut. Turn it off and everything is shown again.

steps.title: Choose what to blur
steps.detail: Pick the kinds of private details to hide in Presenter settings.

steps.title: Let it detect sharing
steps.detail: Turn on auto detection and it blurs when a screen share or recording starts.

steps.title: Force it on or off
steps.detail: Use the shortcut or the Presenter card any time, for example when detection guesses wrong.
